title: Confirmation-campaign contract: confirmation-aware vs strong simple predictors under identical information, deadline and binding-resource cap
status: DRAFT (not frozen). Frozen by protocol/freeze.json before the first outcome read of this study.
evidence_status: Jaaks et al. 2022 (figshare 16843597, SHA-256 1188968c...a278) was opened by feedback_validation_20261003 and analysed by reproducible_allocation_20261003. Everything in this study that reads it is EXPLORATORY. New scripts, partitions or seeds do not make it untouched. Historical thresholds, stop rules, failures and verdicts of earlier studies are unchanged.
primary_question: Under identical two-orientation historical information, an identical two-round deadline and an identical binding-resource cap, does the confirmation-aware predictor R (shrunk empirical joint-call rate) obtain more measured confirmed discoveries than the development-selected strongest simple same-information predictor?
secondary_question: Does purchased target-line feedback improve relative action value (within-line ordering of candidates) beyond a line-level correction of the response level? Gated; one diagnostic only.

action_menu.candidates: per target line and role assignment (SV, VS): the registered S x V menu pairs of the frozen builder research/astra/feedback_validation_20261003/jaaks.py (pairs with both orientations present after the authors' QC)
action_menu.screen(i): buy the screen-orientation measurement of pair i (SV: S drug anchored, V drug titrated; VS: reversed); its label and authors' call are revealed at the end of the round
action_menu.verify(i): buy the other orientation of pair i on disjoint plates; allowed only if screen(i) was bought in an EARLIER round and its call was synergistic (verifying a non-hit has no value under the endpoint); revealed at the end of the round
action_menu.stop: buy nothing more; the cap need not be spent
action_menu.not_in_menu: single-drug probes, re-screens of the same orientation (except the same-condition diagnostic), purchases in other lines

endpoint.primary: measured confirmed discoveries: pairs with a synergistic screen call AND a synergistic verification call, both revealed through purchases before the deadline. Calls follow the authors' rule as implemented by the frozen builder (per anchor concentration >= half of replicate rows synergistic; a pair-orientation is synergistic if so at either anchor concentration).
endpoint.line_value: mean over the two role assignments of the line (paired; never counted as two units)
endpoint.aggregate: sum over evaluation lines; reported absolute (per line) and relative (ratio of sums - 1)
endpoint.not_counted: screen hits not verified by the deadline, and validated-but-unpurchased pairs (reported separately as missed)
endpoint.future_information_utility: none registered: unverified screens bought in a final round carry zero utility in this contract

legal_information.history: other lines of the same tissue, BOTH orientations: screen-orientation and verification-orientation labels (100 x max over anchor concentrations of mean SYNERGY_DELTA_EMAX) and calls, with the frozen builder's QC and provenance. Development targets (HD): history = the other HD lines of the tissue (leave-one-line-out within HD). Evaluation targets (E): history = all HD lines of the tissue. E lines are never history and never enter any selection.
legal_information.target_line: only measurements purchased in earlier rounds of the same campaign. Never the target line's unpurchased outcomes, and never the other role assignment of the same line (its screen measurements are this assignment's verification measurements).
legal_information.excluded: single-drug functional probes, cell-identity or omics features, cheap pre-decision state, LLM output

units.experimental_unit: target cell line (125: 51 breast, 45 colon, 29 pancreas), stratified by tissue
units.partition: protocol/partition.json (design-only, seed [20261004, tissue code]): E = 61 evaluation lines (25/22/14), HD = 64 history-and-development lines (26/23/15); repeat lines: 8 in E, 6 in HD
units.dependence: drug pairs recur across lines (two-way line x pair bootstrap as sensitivity); all E targets share one fixed HD history library (estimand: new lines, same library and history); plates of one line share culture expansions and seeding events (no unit below the line)

resource_cap.binding_resource_primary: orientation measurements: cap M = ceil(0.20 x menu size) per line and role assignment (identical for SV and VS); one purchase = one orientation measurement (all its release plates)
resource_cap.binding_resource_sensitivity: combination wells: cap W = ceil(M x mean over the line's menu of (c_screen + c_verify)/2), c = 14 x design plates behind that orientation (as reproducible_allocation_20261003 physical version)
resource_cap.cap_semantics: a cap, not a spending requirement; actual consumption is reported next to the cap, including unavoidable odd residues
resource_cap.reported_not_matched: dose points (14 per orientation measurement per plate), combination wells, plate starts (custom 1536-well model and native Jaaks plates), control wells (documented 200 per plate; raw layout 216-254), shared single-agent wells, failures, rounds, minimum elapsed days (4 per round: seed-to-read on all 3,106 raw plates), computation. Prices, labour, culture capacity and days beyond the assay stay unknown (null).

deadline.frontier: 1, 2 and 3 rounds evaluated by the resources workstream with the stopping rule

policies.P2_primary_fixed_split: round 1: screen the top n1 = floor((1 - f*) x M) candidates by the predictor's screen score; round 2: verify round-1 screen hits in descending verify score until the remaining cap M - n1 is used or no hits remain; no screens in round 2 (they could not be verified before the deadline); stop.
policies.f_selection: grid f in {0.10, 0.15, ..., 0.60}; selected on HD development targets only (see comparator selection); ties -> smaller f; frozen in design/selection.json before any E outcome is used
policies.P3_sensitivity_verify_hits: 3 rounds: round 1 screens ceil(M/2) by screen score; round 2 verifies round-1 hits first (verify score order), then screens new candidates while screen cost + ceil(sum of history p_s over accepted round-2 screens) fits the remaining cap (reserve for round 3); round 3 verifies round-2 hits only; no round-3 screens; stop.
policies.P1_frontier_paired: 1 round: buy both orientations of the top floor(M/2) pairs by screen score (resources frontier only)
policies.tie_break: identical for every predictor: descending score, then a shared random order per (line, role assignment) from numpy default_rng([20261004, tissue code, line index, role index])

predictors.shrinkage: rates: (count + 2 x pooled_rate)/(n + 2); label means: (sum + 2 x pooled_mean)/(n + 2); n = number of history lines measuring the pair; pooled over the tissue's history rows; p_v|s = (n_joint + 2 x pooled p_v|s)/(n_screen_hits + 2)
predictors.R: screen score p_sv (shrunk P(screen call AND verification call)); verify score p_v|s. A simple shrunk empirical rate, not a learned world model.
predictors.S_both: screen and verify score: shrunk history mean of (screen label + verification label)/2
predictors.L_v: shrunk history mean of the verification label (both scores)
predictors.C_mean: screen score (p_s + p_v)/2; verify score p_v
predictors.C_prod: screen score p_s x p_v (independence product); verify score p_v
predictors.S_info_package_only: shrunk history mean of the screen-orientation label only (one orientation of history: an information-package comparison, never a same-information comparator)
predictors.oracle_reference: ranking by the true joint outcome (headroom only; never a comparator)

comparator_selection: on HD development targets only, under P2 with the primary binding resource: for each simple same-information predictor {S_both, L_v, C_s, C_v, C_mean, C_prod} choose its best f on the grid; the primary comparator C* is the predictor with the highest development confirmed yield at its best f (ties in the listed order); f* = C*'s best f. R and S are excluded from this selection. All predictors, including R, use f* on E.

contrasts.primary: R - C* on E lines under P2 (orientation-measurement cap, 2 rounds, f*)
secondary_registered: R - S_both (if C* is not S_both)
S_both - S and R - S (information package, not modelling contribution)
P3 (verify-hits, 3 rounds) versions of the primary and R - S_both
combination-well cap version of the primary
all-lines leave-one-line-out history sensitivity (125 lines, shared histories)
two-way line x pair bootstrap of the primary
contrasts.reported_for_each: absolute per-line difference and relative gain with 95% intervals; action ordering (within-line concordance of the screen score with the joint outcome over the menu); calibration and prediction error of probability predictors (Brier and log loss of the joint call over the menu); consumption, screen hits, verifications, confirmation rate, missed discoveries

inference: tissue-stratified line bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261004, on per-line paired differences (line = mean of role assignments); 95% percentile intervals

worthwhile_gain.basis: inherited from reproducible_allocation_20261003/review/statistics.json (recommended_tau 0.05 at fixed rounds and resources), not re-tuned; R and C* consume the same information and resources, so tau is the smallest gain worth a confirmatory study and a change of the default ranking

decision_rules_primary.WORTHWHILE_EXCLUDED: 0 <= U < tau and L <= 0 -> STOP (worthwhile benefit ruled out)
decision_rules_primary.SMALL_BENEFIT: L > 0 and U < tau -> adopt R as a free default; STOP pursuing confirmation
decision_rules_primary.BENEFIT_DETECTED: 0 < L <= tau <= U -> CONTINUE to a confirmatory protocol (benefit above zero; worthwhile unresolved)
decision_rules_primary.UNRESOLVED: L <= 0 and U >= tau -> MODIFY: no claim; more or qualified data needed
decision_rules_primary.note: a lower bound below tau never establishes futility; L, U are the 95% interval of the relative gain

feedback_diagnostic.gate: run only if, on HD development targets, (a) the within-policy oracle exceeds the best development predictor by >= 5% under P3, and (b) P3 has a post-feedback screening decision (round-2 screens bought) in >= 50% of development campaigns. P2 has no post-feedback screening decision by construction. The gate result is written before the diagnostic runs.
feedback_diagnostic.signal: F_i = frozen TransferWorld (WorldConfig(context=False)) posterior mean minus prior mean on the screen scale, given the campaign's purchased screen labels; decomposed F_i = m_line + f_i with m_line = mean of F over the eligible set (the line-role campaign's unpurchased menu candidates at the round-2 decision) and f_i = F_i - m_line

models.F0: static calibration: logit P(joint) = a + b x logit(R's p_sv)
models.Fm: F0 + c_m x m_line (line-level correction; cannot change within-line ordering)
models.Ff: Fm + c_f x f_i (one centered coefficient; c_f set to 0 if its development 95% line-bootstrap interval contains 0)

feedback_diagnostic.fitting: all coefficients on HD development campaigns only (legal hidden outcomes of development lines); identical priors, calibration, purchases (round 1) and policy for F0, Fm, Ff
feedback_diagnostic.comparators: existing feedback rankings from reproducible_allocation_20261003/repeats/model_id.py: U_lambda (V0 + lambda x F) and U_screen_post (posterior on the screen scale); report all, including the stronger one
feedback_diagnostic.endpoints: relative action value = within-line concordance of round-2 eligible candidates' predictions with their realised joint outcome (predictions frozen before the round-2 reveal); level correction = calibration-in-the-large and log loss; confirmed yield under P3
feedback_diagnostic.targets: role-swapped transport (all lines) and same-condition repeatability (repeat lines only, seeding-event roles from the provenance receipt) reported separately; same-condition is development-grade (14 lines)
feedback_diagnostic.logging: for every campaign: predictions frozen (hashed) before each paid reveal, scored before updating, complete reveal-score-update history in JSONL
feedback_diagnostic.limits: no latent blocks, networks or feature search; two-parameter logistic calibration is not a new contribution

scheduler_and_llm: no scheduler or LLM arm; added only if the resources diagnostics show substantive choices among screening, verification and stopping that the simple rules mishandle (registered before any such arm is run). p_sv/(c_s + p_s x c_v) is reported as a pipeline diagnostic, not an optimal policy.
power: computed by the design workstream from HD development variance of R - C* under P2 before E outcomes are used: detection (L > 0), demonstration (L > tau) and rule-out (U < tau) for n_E = 61 and other n
data_qualification: verify workstream: bounded recovery attempts for an untouched evaluation of a narrower estimand (design metadata first; builder and analysis frozen before any target outcome is opened); otherwise a blocking receipt with the minimum missing evidence
provider_api: none planned; cap USD 3 if a necessary diagnostic arises; no secrets logged
